1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 e6 3.g3 d5 4.Bg2 dxc4 5.Nf.strategy: Attacks the c4 pawn and pins the knight on c6 to the king, so Black cannot defend the pawn with it. A sharp, direct try to win the pawn back while the king is still in the centre.

Answers with check and blocks the queen's attack on c4. The bishop is guarded by the knight, so White cannot take it and must respond to the check. Black keeps the extra pawn for now and the game turns sharp.
